_comment: t-143 stage-2 composition: one-desk corner, data-driven. Consumes stage-1's frozen sprites (hub/public/office-sprites/sprites/) byte-identical, no pixel edits. seam_y is where the wall plane meets the floor plane. Every object's y is its TOP edge; 'anchor: bottom' objects are placed so their bottom edge sits exactly on seam_y (grounded, nothing floats). Stage 3 consumes this file as-is and only swaps 'desk-agent's sprite between the frame-table entries (idle-anchor.png / typing-0..3.png) to animate; composition (world size, tile layout, wall-monitor position, desk position) is frozen.

objects.note: mounted on the back wall at believable eye-plus height, clear of the desk unit's own screen so the two reads don't collide

self-contained agent+chair+desk+CRT unit per t-141's MANIFEST.md ('stage 2 should treat typing-* as a self-contained agent-at-a-workstation pose, not something to layer piecemeal onto desk-tidy/chair/crt-monitor'). Bottom edge (y+h=90) sits exactly on seam_y: grounded. Stage 3's frame table swaps this entry's sprite between idle-anchor.png (standing, off the desk footprint) and typing-0..3.png (seated, this footprint) to animate the editing/idle verbs; x/y/plane/anchor stay frozen.
